displayPattern: 7-segment display on a Trane S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace (Service Facts S9V2-SF-2A-EN): E10
meaning: Inducer and blower are not communicating: the service facts call this an internal control-board error between those two microprocessors.
causes: Communication error between the inducer and blower-motor microprocessors
diySteps: Write down E10 before power is removed
Technician: the troubleshooting step for fault 10 is to replace the integrated furnace control
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. E10 is a control communication fault. It is not an open-limit code and not an ignition retry.
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
